settlement_cut_off_time.description: The date and time by which funds need to be available to settle the trade, in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

currency_pair.description: Concatenated string of the two currencies traded, e.g. "USDEUR".

client_buy_currency.description: Three character ISO code for the currency being bought.

client_sell_currency.description: Three character ISO code for the currency being sold.

client_buy_amount.description: The amount of buy currency for a client.

client_sell_amount.description: The amount of sell currency for a client.

fixed_side.description: Which currency is fixed -  the buy or sell one.

mid_market_rate.description: The mid point between buy and sell rates.

partner_rate.description: The market rate + Currencycloud's commission (if applicable).

client_rate.description: The rate that will be returned to your customer after all spread has been applied.

deposit_required.description: Is a deposit required for the conversion?

deposit_amount.description: The amount of a deposit required.

deposit_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the currency the deposit is shown in.
